Package com.nexuslink.protocol.rabbitmq

Class RabbitMqManagementClient

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.rabbitmq.RabbitMqManagementClient
public final class RabbitMqManagementClient extends Object
Client for the RabbitMQ HTTP management API (the plugin served on port 15672 at /api). Builds the request paths, attaches HTTP Basic auth, and parses the JSON replies into the small OverviewInfo/QueueInfo/ExchangeInfo/BindingInfo records.

All URL building, vhost encoding, auth-header formatting, and JSON parsing are exposed as static helpers so they can be unit-tested without a running broker.
